description: Checks an IPv4 mail-sending address against the Barracuda Reputation Block List (b.barracudacentral.org) through public DNS. Listed addresses return a 127.0.0.x code; unlisted ones return no record. The list is updated continuously, so this is a point-in-time answer. Domain reputation is not covered. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ip.description: IPv4 address such as 127.0.0.2 (test entry) or a sending IP (required)

name: security_barracuda_reputation
title: Security Barracuda Reputation
